title: CCI imposes penalty on Rekha Agencies and SS Marketing for  indulging in anti-competitive conduct in respect of Himachal Pradesh  Tender 2013 for the procurement of tyres

CCI imposes monetary and non-monetary sanctions on Agro Input  Dealers Association, Agro Input Welfare Association, Mr. Manmohan C.  Kalantri and Mr. Arvindbhai Jerambhai Patel for indulging in anti competitive conduct
CCI approves the acquisition of certain shareholding in Neysa Networks Private Limited by BCP Asia II Topco V Pte. Ltd., Asia II Topco XIV Pte. Ltd., and other investors.

Commission approves the acquisition of a certain stake of Restaurant Brands Asia Limited (Target) by Lenexis Foodworks Private Limited (LFPL), Aayush Agrawal Trust (AAT), Inspira Foodworks Private Limited (IFPL), Aayush Madhusudan Agrawal (AMA), and Inspira Agro Trading LLC (IATL)
